simple.meaning: כֹּרֵם (kôrêm) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a vinedresser.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Joel, beginning at 2 Kings 25:12. The surrounding contexts include flock, land, mountain, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כֹּרֵם (H3755) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: כֹּרֵם (kôrêm) / H3755 is traced through 2 Kings 25:12, 2 Chronicles 26:10, Isaiah 61:5, Jeremiah 52:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.

occurrences.englishText: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock; in the lowland also, and in the plain. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.
Strangers will stand and feed your flocks.
But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.
